Why I Am Interested in Validating on Gno.land:

In an age of increasing corporate control over technology and data, I believe Gno.land embodies the effort to preserve autonomy, transparency, and the open nature of the internet. Supporting this project means supporting the freedom of digital communities to self-govern, innovate, and evolve independently of centralized powers.

Contributions to Gno.land:
I actively participate in the Gno.land testnet, running a stable validator node and helping strengthen the network’s resilience and decentralization. Apollo is an independent validator driven by genuine belief in decentralization and technological progress. Through participation in Gno.land, I aim to contribute both technically and ideologically to a more transparent and self-organizing digital world.

package main

import (
	"gno.land/r/gov/dao"
	valv3 "gno.land/r/sys/validators/v3"
)

func main(cur realm) {
	r := valv3.NewValidatorProposalRequest(
		cross(cur),
		[]valv3.ValoperChange{
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g14m0n559xdj00qwvp6ck0xesprrq26kgprgjt4j"), 5),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1pskxvnzkawh4hze3tdn8u7jj59pcs4ukku7fv5"), 5),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1l3fmz59rw8l6h29hslxt6gtna3th8s7m5vl88d"), 5),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1etf3rd7dqghksj8r5yunkgmvpupdfszdjhuzju"), 5),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g17xcvw4uvehrywupnhncgpm6llat69syhne8s56"), 5),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1y5sclwdy8j6l5m8a5hzsx374k6rvege399zvy9"), 5),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1plf3fmy0h4395jcxxh63g7mzeypr06f9yrdk4d"), 5),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1vvls2tn7zk544fuzt49hgk6k2mdgzrpkwcesnf"), 5),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1jaxzh9epmtachaf6tx6ftxgq6pndcctxrf68tr"), 5),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1ca3kqcjampqpmmlmfnulht2d5zhygrwuly8je0"), 5),
		},
		"Add 10 validator(s) to the valset",
		"Batch-add 10 operator(s) to the active valset with voting power 5.",
	)
	pid := dao.MustCreateProposal(cross(cur), r)
	dao.MustVoteOnProposalSimple(cross(cur), int64(pid), "YES")
	dao.ExecuteProposal(cross(cur), pid)
}

package grc721v2

import "errors"

var (
	ErrInvalidTokenId              = errors.New("invalid token id")
	ErrInvalidAddress              = errors.New("invalid address")
	ErrTokenIdNotHasApproved       = errors.New("token id not approved for anyone")
	ErrApprovalToCurrentOwner      = errors.New("approval to current owner")
	ErrCallerIsNotOwner            = errors.New("caller is not token owner")
	ErrCallerNotApprovedForAll     = errors.New("caller is not approved for all")
	ErrCannotTransferToSelf        = errors.New("cannot send transfer to self")
	ErrTransferFromIncorrectOwner  = errors.New("transfer from incorrect owner")
	ErrTransferToNonGRC721Receiver = errors.New("transfer to non GRC721Receiver implementer")
	ErrCallerIsNotOwnerOrApproved  = errors.New("caller is not token owner or approved")
	ErrTokenIdAlreadyExists        = errors.New("token id already exists")

	// NewBasicNFT realm binding
	ErrNotRealm      = errors.New("rlm must be a realm (got EOA/origin)")
	ErrInvalidName   = errors.New("invalid token name (empty, too long, or contains control chars)")
	ErrInvalidSymbol = errors.New("invalid token symbol (empty, too long, or contains chars outside [A-Za-z0-9_-])")
)
